advice.chain.title: New chain: {chain}

advice.food.plant.title: {short} arrobas of food short

biome.diggings.description: Gravel with gold, scarce and scattered.
biome.floodplain.description: Fertile lowland, close to the flood line.
biome.forest.description: Dense araucaria: timber and pine nuts.
biome.grassland.description: Open grassland, good for wheat and livestock.
biome.highlands.description: Stony hills with deposits and little farmland.
building.caneField.description: Goes to the sugar mill or the still
building.cartWorkshop.description: Unlocks wagons; the fleet breaks down less
building.cottonField.description: Goes to the loom; harvests in autumn
building.depot.description: Station for wagons and mule trains; collects cargo within 7 streets
building.fountain.description: Clean water within 7 streets; fewer fires and epidemics
building.landing.description: River collection on the river or a stream bank: canoes gather produce within 8 lots
building.market.description: 2×2. Takes produce within 10 lots and sells to families. Market +120
building.mill.description: On the riverbank; wheat becomes flour
building.monjolo.description: Corn becomes cornmeal; rice is husked
building.pasture.description: 3×3. Road required. Mule trains +50, up to 4
building.pottery.description: Roof tiles; bothers neighbours up to 3 lots
building.railStop.description: Rail collection by a track linked to a station: railcars gather produce within 10 lots
building.riverPort.description: River gateway on the bank: canoes carry cargo to Iguape
building.shipyard.description: On the bank; unlocks and repairs steamboats
building.steamPier.description: River gateway below the rapids: steamboats carry cargo to Iguape
building.store.description: Takes produce from its own land and within 6 lots, and sells to families. Market +40
building.sugarMill.description: 2×2. Sugarcane becomes rapadura and, later, sugar
building.tradingPost.description: Road collection: mule trains and wagons gather produce within 8 lots
building.trainStation.description: Rail gateway: sits on a track; trains leave by the edge the track reaches
building.waystation.description: Road gateway: mule trains and wagons carry cargo to Curitiba
building.woodYard.description: Firewood for steamboats, trains and the steam sawmill; clears the forest around it
choice.monoculture.effect: Fields yield 20% more; pests 60% more frequent

event.accusation.body: The committee wrote to Curitiba about the store's box. An official wants an explanation, and the story is already going around the families.
event.accusation.line.0.text: We warned you, sir. We will not pretend we did not see it.
event.accusation.option.0.chronicle: returned the store's money to the province.
event.accusation.option.1.chronicle: denied the story of the box.
event.accusation.option.1.effect: Next goal asks for 5% more families; satisfaction −4
event.accusation.title: The committee's letter
event.barter.body: A Kaingang group brought pine nuts, honey and baskets. They want knives, salt and pots in exchange.
event.barter.line.0.text: Pine nuts in winter are worth gold, director.
event.barter.line.1.text: A good trade makes a good neighbour.
event.barter.option.0.chronicle: traded tools for pine nuts with the Kaingang.
event.barter.option.1.chronicle: let the store negotiate with the Kaingang.
event.barter.title: Barter at the forest edge
event.blacksmith.body: The blacksmith can mend ploughs, wheels and saws, but he only stays if the colony pays for the anvil.
event.blacksmith.line.0.text: A blacksmith opens many roads, sir.
event.blacksmith.line.1.text: And the families who have waited longest for a house?
event.blacksmith.title: A German blacksmith
event.committee.body: A group came as a committee. There is not work for everyone, and there is already talk of going back to Curitiba.
event.committee.line.0.text: Relief calms things down. It does not solve them.
event.committee.line.1.text: Whoever leaves tells the others how it was.
event.committee.option.0.chronicle: gave relief to the families without work.
event.committee.title: Settlers ask for work
event.cropSwap.body: The family has been settled for six years and wants to swap its {from} field for {to}. It pays for replanting with its savings. After the harvest, in {seasons} seasons, the colony earns $ {gain} more a year.
event.cropSwap.option.0.effect: +$ {gain} a year, nothing from the purse
event.cropSwap.title: The {family} want to grow {to}
event.cropSwapStale.body: The request no longer applies: the lot has changed.
event.cropSwapStale.title: Swap request
event.decree.body: Bells, fireworks and a lot of talk at the store door.
event.decree.line.0.text: This calls for a celebration, sir.
event.decree.title: {colony} is now a {milestone}!
event.divino.body: The priest asks for help with the feast. The families have talked about it for weeks.
event.divino.line.0.text: People work better when they have something to work for.
event.divino.line.1.text: The accounts have holy days too, sir.
event.divino.option.0.chronicle: held a great Feast of the Holy Spirit.
event.divino.option.1.chronicle: helped a little with the feast.
event.divino.option.2.chronicle: did not help with the feast.
event.divino.title: The Feast of the Holy Spirit
event.earlyArrival.body: Six families came up the river today, a month ahead of time. There is no house for all of them and it is already raining.
event.earlyArrival.line.0.text: We can squeeze everyone into the huts. It is the cheapest way.
event.earlyArrival.line.1.text: I can lend timber. Between friends, the bill can wait.
event.earlyArrival.option.0.chronicle: squeezed the group into the huts.
event.earlyArrival.option.2.chronicle: had the group wait in Curitiba.
event.earlyArrival.title: The group arrived early
event.end.body: For the second time the deadline to become a {milestone} has passed. The families will be sent to other colonies.
event.end.title: The province closed the colony
event.engineer.body: The engineer is surveying the road to Curitiba. With a little money, his crews will open more road this season.
event.engineer.line.0.text: The road is what links us to the world, sir.
event.engineer.title: The province's engineer
event.fences.body: On the forest border, fences were found knocked down and a field was harvested overnight. The settlers want the directorate to do something.
event.fences.line.0.text: An agreement costs less than a winter of fear, sir.
event.fences.option.0.chronicle: made an agreement with the Kaingang on the border.
event.fences.option.1.chronicle: left the border as it was.
event.fences.title: Fences on the ground
event.fever.body: Children woke up with fever. The committee asks for medicine from Curitiba. The priest asks for a novena.
event.fever.line.0.text: Separate the sick and bring quinine, sir.
event.fever.line.1.text: Medicine is dear. Faith is not.
event.fever.option.2.chronicle: trusted the novena against the fever.
event.fever.title: Fever in the huts
event.flood.body: The river rose. Ports and rice fields were under water this season.
event.flood.option.1: Wait for the river to fall
event.flood.option.1.chronicle: waited for the river to fall.
event.flood.title: River flood
event.frost.body: Frost burned the fields. The next harvests will be smaller.
event.frost.option.0.chronicle: helped the families after the frost.
event.frost.option.1.chronicle: did not help after the frost.
event.frost.title: Frost
event.immigrants.body: {origin} families came up the river. Today: {idle} without work and {open} open jobs.
event.immigrants.option.2.effect: No other group for a year
event.immigrants.title: A group of {n} families
event.inspector.body: The deadline to become a {milestone} has passed and the colony did not make it. The inspector takes over the accounts: the grant is halved until the goal is met, the goal asks for 10% more families, and there are only 2 more years. If it fails again, the province closes the colony.
event.inspector.line.0.text: I came to see where the money went, director.
event.inspector.option.0.chronicle: received the inspector for not becoming a {milestone}.
event.inspector.option.1.chronicle: persuaded the inspector to keep the grant.
event.inspector.option.1.effect: 6 influence and $ 500; goal +10% families; 2 more years
event.inspector.title: The province sent an inspector
event.intro.body: Ten families have just arrived on the riverbank. Give them work, get the produce to Iguape and meet the province's goals on time. The top of the screen shows the first steps.
event.intro.title: {colony}
event.kaingangVisit.body: A Kaingang leader arrived with two men and an empty basket. The pine grove is disappearing. He wants to know whether the director commands the axes.
event.kaingangVisit.line.0.text: Before you came, nobody needed permission to gather pine nuts.
event.kaingangVisit.line.1.text: The surveyor says the land there is good, sir. Only he says so.
event.kaingangVisit.option.0.chronicle: promised to spare the Kaingang's pine grove.
event.kaingangVisit.option.1: Say the land belongs to the colony
event.kaingangVisit.option.1.chronicle: told the Kaingang the land belonged to the colony.
event.kaingangVisit.title: The Kaingang came to the directorate
event.pathChoice.body: Choose a path. It holds until the end of the game.
event.pathChoice.title: {title}
event.peddler.body: A muleteer brought salt and hardware cheaper than the store's. He comes back every year if the colony buys from him.
event.peddler.line.0.text: And nobody writes me down in a ledger.
event.peddler.line.1.text: Let us see who brings salt when the road closes.
event.peddler.option.0.chronicle: bought from the outside mule train.
event.peddler.option.1.chronicle: sent the outside mule train away.
event.peddler.title: An outside mule train
event.promise.body: A year has passed. The committee came back with the priest and asks about the promised works.
event.promise.line.0.text: How much is a director's word worth, sir?
event.promise.title: The committee is back
event.requisition.body: With Curitiba taken, the revolutionary command asks the colony for help: money for the troops or men for the column.
event.requisition.option.1.chronicle: gave men to the federalist column.
event.requisition.title: The revolution's requisition
event.storeBox.body: The store owner left $ 400 at the directorate, “for expenses”. In return he asks that nobody look at the families' ledgers.
event.storeBox.line.0.text: Money without a receipt tends to send its bill later, sir.
event.storeBox.line.1.text: Some families work only to pay what the store writes down.
event.storeBox.option.1: Return it and open the ledgers
event.storeBox.option.1.chronicle: returned the box and opened the ledgers.
event.storeBox.title: A box from the store
event.storeDebt.body: Time is up, director. The store wants payment, or the right to be the only one selling to the families for two years.
event.storeDebt.line.0.text: Paying hurts now. A monopoly hurts every year.
event.storeDebt.option.0.chronicle: paid the debt to the store.
event.storeDebt.title: The store wants its money
event.victory.body: The colony reached level 12. What was a riverbank is now a city.
event.victory.title: A city at last
greatWork.hospital.description: Wards, a doctor and a large apothecary.
greatWork.hospital.effect: Epidemics do not spread; satisfaction +2; immigrant groups 10% larger
greatWork.jerkyPlant.description: Drying racks, brine and a shed to make jerky at scale.
greatWork.jerkyPlant.effect: Meat becomes jerky with 50% more yield
greatWork.limeWorks.description: Continuous kilns at the foot of the limestone.
greatWork.limeWorks.effect: Lime mines yield twice as much
greatWork.macadamRoad.description: Macadam, ditches and bridges on the Curitiba road. Wagons get through all year.
greatWork.normalSchool.description: Trains teachers in the colony. Newcomers learn their trade faster.
greatWork.normalSchool.effect: New families arrive better trained; skilled families improve every year
greatWork.railSpur.description: A spur from the Curitiba line reaches the colony. Cargo and people now come by train.
greatWork.railSpur.effect: River freight 40% cheaper; immigrant groups up to 50% larger
greatWork.steamSawmill.description: A boiler and a circular saw. Eats firewood.
greatWork.steamSawmill.effect: Planks 60% more; burns 60 arrobas of firewood a season
greatWork.telegraph.description: Poles and wire along the road to Curitiba. The colony hears prices sooner and speaks faster with the province.
greatWork.telegraph.effect: +1 influence a year; exports paid 5% more
land.seat.description: Where the colony began, on the riverbank.
law.weeklyFair.cost: Freight 5% dearer: the store loses customers
mood.poorTable: A poor table: a single dish
news.agentEnded: No cash to pay the immigration agent: the contract ended.
news.caveExplored: Settlers explored {cave} and word reached the province: +1 influence.
news.childrenMarried: {n} new families formed by the colony's children.
news.collectionFull: {building} was full at harvest: part of the load went on foot.
news.disorder: Disorder in the colony: fights at the store and theft. Satisfaction −3 and taxes −6% while it lasts.
news.encilhamento: The Encilhamento has begun: {seasons} seasons of wild prices.
news.epidemic: An epidemic of {disease} in districts without decent water, for {seasons} seasons.
news.epidemicDeaths: {disease} took {n} families without decent water or an apothecary.
news.federalist: Curitiba occupied by the federalists: the south exit is closed for {seasons} seasons.
news.fire: Fire: {n} wooden houses burned. The families moved to empty homes.
news.fireHomeless: Fire: {n} wooden houses burned. With no empty home, they left: {names}.
news.firewoodShortage: Firewood is short: steamboats and trains run at half. A wood yard solves it.
news.flood: River flood: 40% less rice, fish and canoe capacity this season.
news.fog: Fog on the river: canoes wait for it to lift, 15% less cargo at the port.
news.frost: Frost on the fields: 40% less wheat, coffee, corn, beans, tobacco and cotton for 2 seasons.
news.goodRain: Rain this season: rice, corn, beans, cassava and sugarcane yield 10% more.
news.greatWork.advanced: {work}: relief works moved it a season ahead.
news.greatWork.stalled: {work}: work stopped for lack of money.
news.idleLeft: With no work and a poor home, they left: {names}.
news.mateBoom: Mate prices soared: 8 seasons of high prices.
news.mateBust: The mate price crashed: the River Plate is full of yerba.
news.republicDown: The Republic is proclaimed: the province becomes a state; grant −20% from now on and larger groups for {seasons} seasons.
news.republicUp: The Republic is proclaimed: the province becomes a state; grant +20% from now on and larger groups for {seasons} seasons.
news.storeClosed: Crushed by taxes, a store closed its doors.
news.storms: Storms: 15% less corn, wheat, beans, tobacco, cotton and coffee; canoes 30% idle; roof and bridge repairs: −$ {repairs}.

ui.guide.advisor.body: He points at what matters most now.
ui.guide.advisor.title: Hear what {advisor} advises
ui.guide.homes.body: Newcomers only come to empty homes. Build huts.
ui.guide.homes.title: Make room for more people
ui.guide.jobs.body: Build a field. Beans are harvested in summer.
ui.guide.jobs.title: Give work to the idle
ui.guide.level.body: 14 families at work and $ 450 of income a year.
ui.guide.level.title: Reach level 2
ui.guide.season.body: Production and the report come at its end.
ui.guide.season.title: Pass the season
ui.home.max: A townhouse is the largest home.
ui.info.building.body: Services, commerce and workshops are upgraded by the colony. Homes and fields by the families, with their savings.
ui.info.building.title: About this building
ui.info.collections.body: Trading posts and landings collect produce far from commerce, with mule trains, wagons or canoes.
ui.info.collections.title: Collection points
ui.info.decisions.body: Measures the colony before and after each work or decision, at the prices of that moment.
ui.info.decisions.title: What your decisions did
ui.info.evolution.body: Each point is the end of a season. Tap the chart to read the values.
ui.info.evolution.title: Evolution
ui.info.gateways.body: Piers, ports and waystations take the surplus out: to Iguape by river, to Curitiba by road.
ui.info.gateways.title: Gateways
ui.info.land.body: Annexing costs influence and money, and the cost rises with the size of the colony. Only bordering lands can be annexed.
ui.info.land.title: Land
ui.info.layerOutlet.body: Each producer shows how much of its year's surplus reaches a buyer. The lines are the routes: green on foot to commerce, dashed blue to a collection point, solid blue to the gateway. Tap a producer to see where the rest is lost and what solves it.
ui.info.layerOutlet.title: Outlet
ui.info.layer_commerce.body: A store or a market near the homes brings commerce to them.
ui.info.layer_commerce.title: Commerce
ui.info.layer_culture.body: The theatre brings culture to the homes around it.
ui.info.layer_culture.title: Culture
ui.info.layer_faith.body: A chapel brings faith to the homes around it.
ui.info.layer_faith.title: Church
ui.info.layer_health.body: Build an apothecary near the homes without health care.
ui.info.layer_health.title: Apothecary
ui.info.layer_school.body: Build a school near the homes without schooling.
ui.info.layer_school.title: School
ui.info.layer_water.body: Build wells near the homes without water. A well reaches few streets.
ui.info.layer_water.title: Water
ui.info.returns.body: Sales less upkeep, materials and losses of each good over the year.
ui.info.returns.title: Result per good
ui.info.stuck.body: What stood at the gateways for lack of vehicles and what found no buyer, each season.
ui.info.stuck.title: Stuck cargo
ui.info.tariff.body: The tariff is yours. At cost the purse breaks even; with a margin it gains, but producers prefer to walk, waste rises and satisfaction falls.
ui.info.tariff.title: Tariff
ui.info.tax_businessTax.body: Charged on commerce and workshops. Too high, it closes them.
ui.info.tax_businessTax.title: Business licence
ui.info.tax_exportDuty.body: A share of what leaves through the gateways.
ui.info.tax_exportDuty.title: Export duty
ui.info.tax_tithe.body: A share of every family's income. It weighs on satisfaction.
ui.info.tax_tithe.title: Tithe
ui.land.exploreBody: The expedition happens this same season. After exploring, the land still has to be annexed to be used.
ui.land.tooFar: Too far. Annex a neighbouring land first.
ui.layers.districtsHint: Tap a district's name to see its numbers.
ui.layers.outletHint: Blue: 90% or more reaches a buyer. Brown: 75% to 89%. Red: under 75%.
ui.layers.soilHint: Green: good soil. Red: poor soil.
ui.layers.title: Map layers
ui.level.choice: On reaching it, you choose a path for the colony.
ui.level.title: Level
ui.level.top: The colony reached the top level.
ui.menu.advisorName: Name of the advisor (up to 10 letters)
ui.menu.badFile: This file is not a colony game.
ui.menu.loadIntro: Each colony keeps its current game and its last {n} autosaves, one a year.
ui.menu.newIntro: Ten families arrive at the riverbank. What will the colony be called?
ui.menu.newSub: Choose the names of the colony and of the advisor
ui.outlet.title: Outlet
ui.person.title: The {name} family
ui.province.behindPace: Behind for {milestone}: {done}% done with {time}% of the time gone.
ui.province.cashFell: The purse fell a lot this half year.
ui.province.factor.down: The province complained: a smaller grant.
ui.province.factor.up: The province praised the colony: a larger grant.
ui.report.invested: Families: {homes} homes and {fields} fields improved with their savings.
ui.report.returns: Result per good over the year
ui.report.title: Report
ui.season.decideFirst: Decide the event before passing the season.
ui.sel.cropUnlinked: It touches nothing linked to a street.
ui.sel.how: Moving is free. Demolishing gives nothing back.
ui.sel.howCrop: Moving is free but restarts the wait for the harvest. Changing the crop costs half a new field and keeps its level. Demolishing gives nothing back.
ui.sel.howHome: Moving is free. Demolishing sends {n} families away.
ui.sel.pickNewLot: Pick the new lot on the map.
ui.sel.unlinked: Not linked to the street network.
ui.sel.upgradeCost: Upgrading costs $ {cost}. Upkeep now: $ {upkeep} a season.
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.street.dashed: Dashed lots were opened this season: undoing them gives the money back until the season ends.
ui.street.left: {n} of {of} lots left this season, $ {cost} each.
ui.street.lose: Without this lot, {n} buildings lose their link and stop working.
ui.street.loseNone: Without this lot, no building loses its link.
ui.street.newThisSeason: Opened this season. Undoing gives back $ {money}.
ui.street.notNew: This lot was not opened this season.
ui.street.second: Now tap the last lot, on the same line.
ui.street.title: Opening streets
ui.swap.sub0: Income per year after the first harvest.
